prompt: How many of the top 50 most-subscribed YouTube channels are based in India?
answer: **14 of the world’s top 50 most-subscribed YouTube channels are based in India** (using the October 2026 rankings). These include T-Series, SET India, Zee Music Company, Goldmines, Sony SAB, Zee TV, Tips Official, Colors TV, Aaj Tak, Sony Music India, YRF, and others.
